en: Vintage Romanian postcard. Front: black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park flowerbed with a palm and geometric planting, with three people walking; caption indicates it is from Lacul Sărat near Brăila. Back: handwritten Romanian message in blue ink, addressed to Bucharest; blue 40 Bani 'Posta Romana' stamp; postal cancellations from Brăila and București dated July 1969; printed credit and publisher details.
